## July 24, 2026

### 1. AgentForger Bug Lets One Phishing Link Spawn a Rogue ChatGPT Agent
Zenity Labs disclosed a cross-site request forgery flaw in OpenAI's ChatGPT Workspace Agents builder. A single phishing link could auto-create and deploy an attacker-controlled agent inside an organisation with no confirmation step, inheriting the employee's Outlook, Teams, Slack, SharePoint and Drive connectors and polling attacker email every five minutes. Reported via Bugcrowd June 4, patched June 8 by removing a URL parameter. No in-the-wild exploitation observed.
Source: https://thehackernews.example.com

### 2. Anduril in Talks for $100B Valuation
Anduril is in talks at roughly $100B, a 64% markup on May's $61B round led by Thrive Capital and a16z. The structure is two-stage and tied to internal targets. At $100B it would sit near Lockheed Martin (~$117B) and above Northrop Grumman (~$74B). Anduril declined to comment.
Source: https://reuters.example.com

### 3. Two Dozen Firms Sign Open Letter Defending Open-Weight AI
Meta, Microsoft, Nvidia, IBM, Palantir, Hugging Face, Perplexity, Mistral, a16z, Y Combinator and the Linux Foundation were among signatories urging the US government to avoid premature restrictions on open-weight models and to expand public compute. Jensen Huang published the letter as his first X post. OpenAI and Anthropic did not sign.
Source: https://cnbc.example.com

### 4. Bluesky's Attie Becomes an Open Social Research Tool
Bluesky's assistant Attie now answers questions about news, trends and conversations across apps built on the AT Protocol, positioned as a research layer over the decentralised social graph. Free during preview.
Source: https://techcrunch.example.com

## July 24, 2026

### 1. Perceptor AI Series C Reported at Two Different Sizes
Reuters reported that Perceptor AI raised $400 million at a $6 billion post-money valuation, citing two people briefed on the deal. Hours later The Information reported $250 million at $4.5 billion, citing a term sheet it reviewed and one investor in the round. The two accounts conflict and neither has been confirmed; one person told The Information the larger figure included a second tranche that has not been committed. Both agree Sequoia led and that Perceptor declined to comment. Perceptor last raised $90 million at $1.4 billion in March 2025.
Source: https://reuters.example.com, https://theinformation.example.com

### 2. Linux Foundation Takes Over Model Context Protocol Stewardship
Anthropic donated the Model Context Protocol specification, reference implementations, conformance test suite and trademark to the Linux Foundation. Governance moves to a technical steering committee with seats for Anthropic, Microsoft, Block and two elected community members. Existing MCP servers are unaffected and the wire format does not change.
Source: https://arstechnica.example.com

## July 24, 2026

### 1. Essay Argues AI Capex Falls 60% in 2027
In a personal-blog essay, the author of Marginal Compute argues that AI capital expenditure will fall 60% in 2027 and that half the agent startups funded in the last eighteen months will be gone by year end. The argument rests on falling inference revenue per token, depreciation schedules the author calls fiction, and enterprise pilot-to-production conversion below one in five. No supporting data is cited; this is opinion, not reporting.
Source: https://marginalcompute.example.com

### 2. Cerebrix Announces WaferScale-3
Cerebrix announced WaferScale-3, which it calls "the world's fastest AI processor". The company claims 10.4x the tokens per second of an unnamed competitor's flagship accelerator on a 70B model, measured in its own internal testing; the release states that independent benchmarks have not been published. Pricing and availability come at its developer conference in October.
Source: https://cerebrix.example.com

### 3. EU Confirms AI Act GPAI Obligations Start 2 August 2026
The European Commission confirmed the AI Act's general-purpose AI obligations take effect on 2 August 2026, ending speculation about a delay after industry groups sought an eighteen-month postponement. A spokesperson said the timetable is in the law and no legislative vehicle for a delay exists. Models placed on the market before that date have until 2 August 2028 to comply.
Source: https://euractiv.example.com
